select video_user_id user_id, action_type data_type,sum(action_count) statistics_count from user_action where DATE_FORMAT(action_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=#{statisticsDate} and action_type in (2,3,4) group by video_user_id,action_type
select v.user_id user_id ,sum(1) statistics_count from video_danmu vd left join video_info v on vd.video_id = v.video_id where DATE_FORMAT(post_time,'%Y-%m-%d')=#{statisticsDate} group by v.user_id

select ifnull(sum(play_count),0) playCount, ifnull(sum(like_count),0) likeCount, ifnull(sum(danmu_count),0) danmuCount, ifnull(sum(comment_count),0) commentCount, ifnull(sum(coin_count),0) coinCount, ifnull(sum(collect_count),0) collectCount from video_info
and user_id = #{userId}

select sum(statistics_count) as statistics_count,data_type,s.statistics_date from statistics_info s
group by data_type,statistics_date

select count(1) statistics_count, DATE_FORMAT(join_time,'%Y-%m-%d') as statistics_date from user_info
and user_info.join_time>=str_to_date(#{query.statisticsDateStart}, '%Y-%m-%d')
and user_info.join_time< date_sub(str_to_date(#{query.statisticsDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d'),interval -1 day)
group by statistics_date order by statistics_date asc
